coupon_title: Steal the Brainrot Fortnite Admin Commands
coupon_short_description: Get access to the Admin Panel in Steal the Brainrot Fortnite
coupon_description: <p>Steal the Brainrot is just one of the many Creative Maps that feature secret codes players can use to earn in-game rewards specific to that map. To use codes in Steal the Brainrot, players can simply head over to the game's keypad terminal, which can be found in the center of both the shop and the Galaxy Spin wheel.</p>
